rawContent: @inihelene I'm not "blaming a movement of equality" for violence against women. If you knew anything about my work, you'd know I was a strong supporter of #MeToo. But to deny that feminists' radical solutions have ended up hurting women along the way is denying a sad reality women now face.

The #MeToo movement identified a problem, and radical feminists have offered their solution. To deny their solution has wound up hurting women is denying a sad reality. The pendulum has swung too far in the opposite direction and your inability to acknowledge this makes it worse.

@inihelene Agreed—it's an unacceptable "solution." So let's address why they're doing that. Could it be the #MeToo movement has gone too far? Could it be the movement has lost its way? https://t.co/kBFxVqyzk2

And if you don't want to take it from me since I'm a conservative and conservatives couldn't possibly(!) be right, perhaps you'll take it from the founder of #MeToo, who wrote "the movement has lost its way." https://t.co/kBFxVqyzk2
